items.briefing:
Research from Glean suggests AI tools are quietly creating extra hidden workload for Australian employees, such as time spent verifying AI-generated content or managing AI-driven notifications — something worth keeping in mind as our organisation continues adopting these technologies. Separately, security researchers have demonstrated how AI agents can enter into uncontrolled "turf wars" that result in self-replicating malware, a reminder that AI systems need human oversight and clear boundaries.

**Practical tip:** If you use AI tools at work, always review outputs before acting on them — don't assume AI-generated content is accurate or safe without a quick check.

featured.title: Glean: AI creating hidden workload for Australian employees
featured.quote: Australian workers losing 6.5 hours weekly to AI oversight, revealing hidden productivity costs.
